intro: Horumariye bilow ah. Waxaan maamulaa adeegga martigelinta server-ka ASHIKA Network iyo liiska server-yada Minecraft SABALISU, waxaanan sameeyaa barnaamijka server-ka Minecraft Storia.
about: Weli waan cusubahay, laakiin maalin kasta waan qoraa koodh waanan horumarayaa
Su'aalaha ku saabsan adeegyadayda ama tiknoolajiyadda waa la soo dhoweynayaa: kaliya ii salaan Discord
can_write: Waxa aan qori karo (oo ay ku jiraan koodh qasan)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: server-yo ka bilaabma 30 yen bishii
anw_p:
Adeeg martigelin ah oo loogu talagalay dadka doonaya inay server shaqeysiiyaan laakiin aan awoodin inay lacag badan bixiyaan.
Yar ka bilow, **laga bilaabo 30 yen oo keliya bishii**.
sab_p:
Ku dar server-kaaga Minecraft liiska oo hel dad kula ciyaara.
Waxtar u leh ciyaartoyda raadinaysa server iyo milkiilayaasha doonaya inay xayeysiiyaan kooda.
storia_t: Storia: barnaamij server oo loogu talagalay server-yada waaweyn ee Minecraft
storia_p: Fork il furan oo Folia ah oo loogu talagalay Minecraft 26.2. Iyadoo la adeegsanayo **Storia Cluster**, hal adduun ayaa hal mar ku shaqeyn kara dhowr server, ciyaartoyduna way kala guuraan iyagoo aan lahayn shaashad soo dejin.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: hal adduun oo ay wadaagaan dhowr server, isku xirkooduna waa sir
**Relay kayd ah**: relay labaad ayaa haya nuqul nool wuxuuna la wareegaa haddii kan koowaad lumo
**Qaabka Linear**: adduunku wuxuu qaataa ku dhawaad kala badh boosaska diskiga
**Adduun RAM ku jira**, **Tick Guard**, API plugin oo xogta la wadaago, iyo in ka badan
welcome: Wax walba waa la soo dhoweynayaa!
